description: Use when the user asks: 'load a directory skill', 'use the sync brief method'. Call after directory_skill_list, to load the one skill the user's request matches (e.g. find-music-for-sync-brief). Returns the full methodology body for one directory skill — markdown with step-by-step instructions and tool chains. Call directory_skill_list first to see available skill names, then directory_skill_get to load one. Read once at the start of the workflow; do not re-fetch on every step. → then: directory_search (run the loaded methodology against the catalogue)
name: directory_skill_get
title: Get a directory skill
